# Recreation Prompt

Recreate a browser-native portrait-first Ludo board race called “Mooncake Ludo: Bestie Orbit.” Preserve a two-team Ludo / Parcheesi loop: human player versus bot, four tokens per side, six required to leave home, dice roll 1-6, one legal token move per roll, extra turn on six, capture opposing track tokens on shared path cells, transition into a six-cell home stretch, and win after all four tokens finish. Present it as a candycore pixel-art magical-girl satire with Pink Bestie sugar scouts racing Blue Chaos around a mooncake board toward the Moon Castle. Use large touch-friendly dice and token taps, short readable mobile copy, authored procedural canvas art, crescent/star/sprinkle motifs, meme-tone feedback such as “real” and “bestie,” and search-friendly surface language around ludo, board game, dice, and mobile multiplayer-style play.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Current implemented game identity
- genre: browser-native two-team Ludo / Parcheesi-style board race against a simple bot.
- objective: roll dice, launch tokens from home only on sixes, race four player tokens around the 52-step loop and into the home stretch before the bot completes its four tokens.
- input model: one-thumb click/tap on the dice when it is the human turn, then tap a highlighted/valid human token on the canvas; start and restart are normal buttons.
- core loop: start game, roll randomized die, validate legal moves, move one token, capture opposing tokens on matching track cells, grant extra turn on six, otherwise alternate turn with the bot.
- fail/friction state: no legal move after a roll causes a short blocked feedback state and turn switch; terminal state is a win screen when all four tokens for a side are FINISHED.

## Protected mechanics
- Preserve dice values 1-6 and the roll gating that allows one move per rolled value.
- Preserve HOME tokens launching only on a roll of 6.
- Preserve the 52-position main path, red start at path index 0, blue offset by 26 positions, and six-cell home stretches.
- Preserve valid-move overshoot checks into the home stretch and FINISHED state at home-stretch index 5.
- Preserve capture semantics: an opposing TRACK token occupying the same absolute path cell returns HOME.
- Preserve turn semantics: six grants another turn, non-six switches turn, bot auto-rolls and auto-selects a valid token.
- Preserve canvas token tap hit testing, HUD dice click input, start/restart flow, win condition, and mobile portrait actionability.

## Remixed target
Mooncake Ludo: Bestie Orbit reframes the same board race as a candycore, pixel-art, satirical magical-girl ludo duel. The human team is the Pink Bestie sugar-scout squad, the bot is Blue Chaos, the dice is a mooncake die, captures are meme-drama banishments back to the dressing room, and finishing means reaching the Moon Castle. The rebuild keeps mechanics intact while replacing scene ownership, HUD vocabulary, token silhouette, palette, background motifs, and mobile onboarding with a sugarcore board-game identity.
